title: the TPyFunction group types leave the definitions: a user function's signature is that of its def
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026b step RG12.4.7 (maintainer 2025-09-25): the 24 group names of definitionTypes.userFunctionSignatures were a lookup key stated next to the def; checked first that the std::function derived from each def's annotations equals the group's for all 34 user functions (RG12.4.7.1), then the type= removed: ItemDefinition gives each user function the type PyFunction<Item><Parameter> with the std::function of its def, the documentation shows the Protocol name, the symbolic set has one member per signature named after its first user function.
releaseNotes: A user function of an item takes its C++ signature from its def in the definitions; the reference manual shows the name of its Protocol as its type.
